children: Novo Nordisk (NVO) shares fell as much as 6% early Monday after the drugmaker outlined its long-term strategy and obesity ambitions at its Capital Markets Day in London.

The company is targeting more than $23 billion in annual obesity sales by 2030 and plans to bring more than five medicines with blockbuster potential to market. It also aims to have at least five Phase 3 programs in both obesity and diabetes and other treatment areas.

Novo Nordisk said it expects to expand oral GLP-1 capacity enough to serve 10 times more people with obesity by 2030. Management also plans to keep its adjusted operating margin broadly stable and maintain dividend growth through the period.

The outlook comes as Novo prepares for heavier competition and the eventual loss of semaglutide exclusivity. CEO Mike Doustdar said the company must strengthen its pipeline as rivals pursue the same market, while focusing on new treatments that can support growth beyond Wegovy and Ozempic.

title: Novo Nordisk Shares Sink After $23 Billion Obesity Sales Target for 2030
